Checked and correct. The diff adds 12 lines and deletes none, so no content is lost. All three embeds use modes and presets that exist in src/lib/sv-stream-model.ts: stream, cast, the default big-endian, the default round-trip, and whole-vs-field. The lab's numbers match the sources. The per-field swap gives 04_EFBE_01 and the whole-struct swap gives 01EF_BE04. The 40-bit target is zero-filled on the right, and a 24-bit target is an error (§11.4.14). In the 40-bit unpack, the AA low byte is ignored (§11.4.14.3). {<< 4 {6'b11_0101}} gives 'b0101_11 (§11.4.14.2). Nested streaming, as in the per-field form, is legal: §11.4.14.2 has the example {<< 2 {{<< {4'b1101}}}}. The cast pitfalls are right: the cast type must be a single type name (§6.24.1), the sizes must be equal (§6.24.3), and x becomes 0 in a 2-state destination (§6.24.3, §6.11.2). The lab only shows its compare rows after the learner commits an answer. The rows it shows match the casting table, so the OperatorExplorer A55A/1234 prompt and the three cast cards are not given away.
